info.title: skcal API
info.summary: Typed HTTP API for skcal — calorie and body-composition tracking, built to wire into developer + AI tooling.
info.description:
HTTP API behind [skcal](https://app.skcal.fit), a calorie and body-composition tracker built for developers and AI power users — drive it from the CLI or straight from this typed API (MCP server planned).

Every record is scoped to the signed-in account's email, so one account can never read another's data. The scale-ingest route is the one exception — it is authenticated with a bearer token and attributes readings to a configured owner.

Nutrition is logged from a freeform text description, which is sent to Claude, which returns per-item calories and protein.

post.description: Uploads 1–5 photos of a single meal, sends them to Claude vision for per-item calorie and protein estimates, stores the photos plus a meal, and returns the analysis.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to log against (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the server's current UTC date.

requestBody.description: The meal photos (multipart field `photos`), plus an optional `note` caption for context.

photos.description: 1–5 photos of a single meal, possibly from multiple angles (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF; max 8MB each).

note.description: Optional caption to disambiguate the photo; passed to the model and stored as the meal note.
note.example: the white sauce is toum, and that's a 12oz steak

200.description: The meal was analyzed and logged.

post.summary: Log a meal or workout from photos
post.description: Uploads 1–5 photos, classifies what they show — food, workout evidence (machine console, app/watch summary, whiteboard), a scale readout, or a tape-measure/measuring-app reading — and logs the matching entry (meal, workout, weigh-in, or body measurement). Returns the classification in `kind`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to log against (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (as from getTimezoneOffset), used to anchor a dated workout.

requestBody.description: The photos (multipart field `photos`), plus an optional `note` caption for context.

photos.description: 1–5 photos of one meal or one workout (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF; max 8MB each).

note.description: Optional caption; trusted over the pixels when they disagree.

200.description: The photos were classified and, unless `kind` is `other`, logged.

post.summary: Log a meal from a description
post.description: Sends a freeform meal description to Claude for per-item calorie and protein estimates, respecting stated portions and excluding anything the user says they skipped, then stores it as a meal.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to log the described meal against (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the server's current UTC date.

requestBody.description: The freeform meal description to analyze.

200.description: The meal description was analyzed and logged.

get.description: Returns the caller's logged meals for a day, each with its food items, newest first.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to list (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the server's current UTC date.

200.description: Meals for the day, newest first.

delete.description: Removes one of the caller's meals, its food items, and any stored photos, then recomputes the day's totals.
Removes a single logged food item and recomputes the affected day's totals.

get.description: Streams a stored meal photo from object storage. The key is owner-prefixed, so callers can only read their own photos. Note that the key contains slashes.

404.description: No photo exists at that key.

post.summary: Log a workout from a description
post.description: Parses a freeform description of a workout into a normalized row (activity type, duration, distance, heart rate, strength exercises) and logs it.

requestBody.description: The workout description and optional local day.

200.description: The workout was parsed and logged.

get.description: Returns the caller's workouts whose start time falls on the given local day, newest first.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Client timezone offset in minutes (getTimezoneOffset) used to bound the local day.

schema.description: Workouts started on the requested local day.

delete.description: Removes one of the caller's workouts.

post.description: Sends a short chat history to Claude with a system prompt grounded in the caller's own targets, today's logged calories and protein, and their latest weight and weekly trend. Use it before eating to get a blunt verdict on a food and how it fits the remaining budget. The client holds the conversation history and posts the whole thing each turn.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to ground today's intake against (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the server's current UTC date.

requestBody.description: The chat history to answer, oldest message first.

get.description: The machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 description of this API, generated from in-code comments.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the signed-in account and everything it owns: weigh-ins, measurements, meals, food items, photos, workouts, targets, agent conversations and memories, reminders, API keys, linked phone numbers, sessions, and the sign-in itself. A Stripe subscription is cancelled. An App Store subscription has to be cancelled in the Apple ID settings. Requires a signed-in session; API keys and the messaging agent cannot call it. This cannot be undone.

200.description: The account and all of its data were deleted.

403.description: Called with an API key or by the messaging agent, which cannot delete accounts.

502.description: Stripe or the iMessage provider refused the cleanup. The account's data was not deleted; retry.

503.description: The account has a Stripe customer but billing is not configured. The account's data was not deleted.

get.description: Returns every bulk, cut, and maintenance phase (newest first) with planned vs actual weekly rate of weight change, the open phase, and a maintenance-calorie estimate from the caller's own intake and weigh-ins (null until there are 10+ logged days across two weeks).

200.description: The caller's phases with progress and the maintenance estimate.

post.description: Starts a bulk, cut, or maintenance phase and closes the open one. Omitted fields are filled in: start weight from the latest weigh-in, rate from the kind's default (+0.25% / -0.5% / 0% bodyweight per week), goal weight projected to the planned end, and daily calories from data-driven maintenance plus the rate's surplus or deficit. The phase's numbers are written to the caller's targets.

requestBody.description: The phase to start.

patch.description: Partially updates a phase (dates, goal, rate, calories, protein, note). The kind can't change; start a new phase instead. Editing the open phase updates the targets too.

requestBody.description: The phase fields to change.

delete.description: Permanently removes a phase from the history. Targets are left as they are.

post.description: Closes the open phase on the given day (default today) without starting another.

get.description: Everything needed to build a mesocycle: muscle groups with their weekly volume landmarks (MV, MEV, MAV, MRV hard sets), equipment types, split templates, the feedback questions and answers, and the exercise library (built-in plus the caller's own exercises).

parameters.name: muscle
parameters.description: Only return exercises for this muscle key.

post.description: Adds an exercise to the caller's library so it can be picked in a mesocycle.

requestBody.description: The exercise.

delete.description: Removes one of the caller's custom exercises. Mesocycles already using it keep their copy of the name.

get.description: Every mesocycle (newest first) with its progress and week-by-day calendar, plus the active one.

post.description: Plans a mesocycle from a split template or explicit days of muscle slots. The last week is a deload. Week 1 starts each muscle at its MEV split across its slots, at 3 reps in reserve; later weeks are planned from what was lifted and the per-muscle feedback. One mesocycle can be active at a time.

requestBody.description: The plan.

get.description: The active mesocycle's next session due (the first week/day not yet completed) with its exercises, sets, targets, last week's results, and feedback.

200.description: The next session, or active false when no mesocycle is running.

get.description: One mesocycle with its calendar, day plans (slots), and planned sets per muscle per week beside each muscle's landmarks.

patch.description: Renames it, edits its notes, or ends it early with status completed or abandoned.

requestBody.description: The mesocycle fields to change.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a mesocycle and its sets and feedback. Workouts its completed sessions logged stay in the workout history.

get.description: One training session (week + day number) with its exercises, sets, targets, last week's results, and per-muscle feedback. A later week not yet planned is planned on read from the week before.

post.description: Marks the session done, logs it as a strength workout in the workout history, and plans the same day next week from this week's results and feedback. Finishing the last session completes the mesocycle.

put.description: Records feedback for one muscle in one session, the input to next week's set progression. Soreness (asked before the muscle's first exercise) is how it recovered since it was last trained; pump, joint pain, and workload are asked after its last exercise. Each is the index of an answer in the library's feedbackScales.

requestBody.description: The feedback.

post.description: Logs sets the way a person says them ("bench 185 for 8, 8, 7"): finds the exercise in a session (default the active mesocycle's next one) by name or muscle, fills its unlogged sets in order, and adds sets when more were done than planned.

requestBody.description: The exercise and the sets done.

patch.description: Sets a set's weight and reps (logging it), un-logs it with done false, or edits its targets.

requestBody.description: The set fields to log or change.

delete.description: Removes one set from a session.

post.description: Adds a set to an exercise slot for one week, copying the last set's targets.

requestBody.description: The week to add the set to.

patch.description: Replaces a slot's exercise from the given week on (default all unlogged weeks). Logged sets keep the exercise they were done with.

requestBody.description: The replacement exercise, by id or name.

sessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth session. Signing in (Google or email magic link) sets an HttpOnly session cookie that scopes every request to that account. The web app and CLI use this; agents use the OAuth 2.1 flow of the MCP server.

bearerApiKey.description: Personal API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer skcal_…`. Create and scope keys in the app under your profile → API keys. Keys default to full access; a scoped key is limited to its granted `resource:action` permissions and cannot manage other keys.

ingestToken.description: Shared secret carried as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, used only by the scale-ingest route.

BadRequest.description: The request body or parameters failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or incorrect ingest bearer token.

Forbidden.description: The requested resource belongs to another user.

NotFound.description: No matching resource owned by the caller.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required secret (model key or ingest token) is not configured.
